title: Diagnostic Fee Hours and Diagnostic Credit Terms by Tier — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
| Tier | Diagnostic hours charged per concern line | Diagnostic fee credited on an authorized repair | Credit window (calendar days after the diagnosis) | Share of the fee credited | No fee when the failure is repaired under a recall, warranty or service contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 1.0 | No | 0 | 0% | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 1.0 | Yes | 14 | 50% | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 1.0 | Yes | 30 | 100% | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 0.5 | Yes | 30 | 100% | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 1.0 | Yes | 30 | 100% | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 1.0 | Yes | 30 | 100% | Yes |

These are the diagnostic figures of each tier of **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**. The diagnostic hours are multiplied by the posted labor rate of the store to give the fee. The credit window counts calendar days from the diagnosis date, which is day 0.

**Reading the table (hypothetical).** On an account at Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum diagnosed at a store whose posted rate is a hypothetical 140.00, the diagnostic hours of 0.5 give a fee of 70.00. On an account at Service Guest Account the column for credits reads No, so that tier carries no diagnostic credit on an authorized repair.
